versions.changelog: Add book search, disable environment proxies and redirects, add security tests, and split detailed guidance into references.
Use a locale-neutral system font stack so the dashboard language is determined only by the user's selected language data.
Eliminate dashboard HTML injection by using one HTML-escaped JSON data block and textContent-only rendering, add a restrictive CSP, and make locale plus weekday labels explicitly user-selected.
Declare the helper's network and environment capabilities explicitly so SkillSpector can verify least privilege while preserving the fixed WeRead gateway and user-consent gate.

Address SkillSpector findings: replace shell/curl networking with a scoped Python helper, declare minimum tool and runtime requirements, remove hidden HTML comments, and localize dashboard language and UI text.
Declare OpenClaw runtime requirements, enforce HTTPS/TLS fail-closed gateway access, and eliminate permissive or duplicate requests.
Close the remaining audit findings: remove shell-based file opening and remote font requests, add a per-request private-data confirmation gate to the helper script, and fix 375px dashboard overflow.
Align audit-safe skill with the canonical repository; document explicit WeRead triggers, consent before private context access, and confirmation before file writes or opening.

weread-ai-brain 2.0.0 introduces a powerful overhaul transforming your WeRead data into comprehensive AI-driven insights and visual dashboards.

- 全面升级三大能力：可视化看板、AI 深度分析、知识重构导出
- 新增支持 Markdown 和精美 HTML 看板（深色/亮色，响应式与主题切换）
- 六大可视化模块：核心指标、12周绿墙热力图、24小时脑波图、知识品类光谱+AI认知盲区、MBTI 灵魂卡片、AI 分析卡片
- 全面接入微信读书官方Skill API（POST统一网关，专属API Key流程指引）
- 明确模板规范、CSS设计、数据占位符、条件渲染等前后端要求
- 详细规范触发词、模块内容与算法规则，支持结构化导出与后续扩展
